ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Bimodal high-contrast distribution; approximately 35-40% of visible pixels occupy high-intensity range (230-255) at the distal tips, while 60-65% occupy low-intensity range (0-40) in the central and proximal fluke body.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity (white) contiguous geometric blobs mapped to the distal margins of both lobes, most prominently on the right lobe. Low-intensity (black) contiguous area mapped to the peduncle attachment and central-proximal fluke surface. High-frequency black-on-white mottling transitions occur at the mid-lobe boundary.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration profile extracted along the right lobe trailing edge; pixel variations of 8-18 units forming sharp peaks; jagged irregularities concentrated on the distal one-third of the lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Highly convex 2D geometric curve fitted to the outer lateral margin of the right lobe; left lobe sweep partially occluded by water surface and spray.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial detection of roughly 12-15 circular high-contrast white pixel clusters (5-12 pixel diameter) located within the low-intensity central-lower pigmentation zone.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of high-density, multi-directional linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering >70% of the right lobe; prominent parallel horizontal scratches intersecting the white distal tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical trauma detected as a deep, jagged V-shaped indentation on the distal trailing margin of the right lobe; extensive healed linear rake marks visible across entire exposed ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mosaic-like pigmentation pattern on the right lobe where high-frequency black linear marks create a 'shattered' visual effect against the white background.
